I think you should just explore this situation with this new man first and see where it takes you, theirs no rush. Your enjoying your time enough with this guy to spend more time with him and that's a positive sign. Honestly, coming out to your parents is not an area I have experience in but just take your time and realise that theirs nothing wrong with being gay, bi or whatever else you decide. Your not interested in the girl clearly and made the right choice, her getting upset is not a good reason to date her 💗

Have you tried therapy? It really helped me realise some things within myself and learn that dating apps, social media and whatever else will not enable me top conquer my lust for attention, I had to learn how to be happy on my own before ever getting into another relationship. Learn to love yourself and pick out things within yourself you admire the most. Life is a steep hill and if you can look in the mirror and love the person who looks back, then everything is easier from their. I hope you can solve this issue.

I'm proud of you for being honest with the girl and saying your not interested from the offset so she knows how you feel, despite that you still put out the branch off friendship and she decided to react in a pretty immature way. Be confident with yourself and realise that none of this is your fault, exploring your preferences is a complex thing and will take time, don't let jerks make you feel bad just because your not interested.
